comment: x-ms-user-quota-remaining is exactly '1' (Req 20.3): the boundary value for 'issue the next paged request immediately, with no interposed wait'. A collector that treats only values strictly greater than 1 as free of a wait would wait unnecessarily here and this fixture exists to catch exactly that off-by-one. Carries a skipToken so a real collector does have a next request to issue immediately.
